project.title: RC step response
project.question: How long does the capacitor take to charge?
project.notes:
Expected: τ = RC = 1 ms. The output is about 0.63212 V after 1 ms and 0.99326 V after 5 ms.
Try: Double R1 and observe a 2 ms time constant. Keep the maximum step small relative to τ.
assumptions: Lumped circuit elements and ideal independent sources.
Model outputs are numerical predictions; validate a physical design using component data and measurements.

engine.name: CircuitBench coordinated transient
engine.package: CircuitBench stateful MNA and event kernel
engine.execution: Stateful modified nodal analysis and incremental digital events in an isolated worker
engine.coupling: Causal shared timeline; analog trial-step threshold localization; digital events and converter samples create analog breakpoints
engine.limitations: R/C/L and independent V/I sources only in the analog partition. Fixed maximum step with backward-Euler numerical damping; no transistor, diode, opamp, switch, noise or thermal model.

diagnostics.message: Transient uses specified capacitor/inductor initial conditions (UIC); a DC operating point is skipped.

logs: Coordinated session advanced 1001 accepted steps from 0s to 0.005s without resetting numerical or digital state.
